title: Your $3,000 Bonus Silently Becomes $2,340
hook: Your boss hands you a $3,000 holiday bonus — and by the time it hits your bank, it's $2,340. That $660 didn't disappear by accident.
angle: The IRS forces companies to withhold a flat 22% on all bonuses via the supplemental wage rate — not your real tax bracket — and two legal moves can recover or redirect that money most workers never know about.
audience: Anyone expecting a year-end or holiday bonus who's never scrutinized why the deposit amount never matches the stated amount
key_numbers: 22% flat supplemental withholding rate on bonuses under $1 million
$1,900 average annual bonus for US workers
$418 average recoverable difference at tax time for a typical bonus recipient
65% of workers don't understand how bonus taxation works
